desc: Define the F(x) prefix-count reduction for the range (F(0)=0, answer = F(r) - F(l-1)).
Verify the reduction with the two provided examples (10,20)->2 and (1,15)->10.
Precompute the by-length suffix table suffix[j][(sum,product)] over digits 0-9 (leading zeros allowed, product 0 absorbing).
Implement `count_upto(n)` combining the by-length tables with a tight prefix walk and an explicit test of n itself; answer = count_upto(r) - count_upto(l-1).
Handle edge cases: n<=0 -> 0, first digit 1..9, beauty test p==0 or p%s==0.
Run provided examples and brute-force cross-check; worst case r=999999999 runs fast; sample tests pass.
